status: Engineering assembly substitution; physical measurements pending
legacy_label_rule: The unchanged native J2 model records the original regulator. This file and harnesses.json select the current offboard assembly; do not purchase the legacy regulator for PWR1.

regulator.pin_orientation: Identify the pin-1 dot on the broad face. With that face towards you, dot at lower left and leads down, pins 1, 2, 3 run left to right. PCB top view and underside view must not be confused.
regulator.efficiency_reference_condition: Datasheet full-load value at minimum input; not a measured hub efficiency or a constant at all loads.
protection: continuous short-circuit protection with automatic recovery
unprovided_protection: No protection against externally driven VOUT assumed

input_capacitor.reason: RECOM requires a 27 uF electrolytic at VIN-GND for hard plugging or excessive input slew; the 5 V assembly includes it rather than treating the >18 V emphasis as an exemption.

input_connection.source: Active isolated 5 V PoE splitter through inline fuse and carrier J1
input_connection.headroom_rule: Verify >=4.5 V at regulator pins 1-2 once input has entered regulated operation, including turn-on load transients and simultaneous load. Account for splitter tolerance, fuse, wire and contact drop. Verify clean startup without UVLO cycling during the initial ramp from zero. UVLO below 4.5 V does not extend the specified operating range. Never connect raw PoE or battery voltage.

rail_loads.published_current_kind: Manufacturer specifies 3.3 V; no worst-case module current published in referenced specification
TI chip current varies with RF power, frequency and temperature; this is a module reserve, not a certified maximum. A PA-equipped replacement requires a new budget.
Manufacturer operating current is less than 3 mA
Bosch Table 2 bare-sensor heater-start peak maximum under its stated conditions; not the breakout's guaranteed total

rail_loads.part: Carrier and module pull-ups, indicators and allowance

excluded_loads: U1 host: +5V_HOST through D1 and its own regulator
U2 TinyC6[D]: +5V_C6 through D2 and its own regulator
U3 XIAO MG24: +5V_ZB through D3 and its own regulator
budget.interpretation: Sizing reserve for the present peripheral rail only; not an idle-current estimate, measured peak, whole-hub power budget or PoE input-power prediction.

perfboard.grid: 8 columns A-H left to right, 8 rows 1-8 top to bottom, component-side view
perfboard.build_rule: Use insulated point-to-point links on the solder side; crossings are insulated, never solder-bridged. Gently form the capacitor's 2.0 mm leads to the 2.54 mm pad spacing without bending at the seal. Seat and restrain both bodies; do not use the SIP leads as structural supports. Route the J2 cable through strain relief. Verify all three nets by continuity before powering. Remove all unused row-8 pads and any copper in the rear strap band Y20.5-23 mm. Route the harness away from this band.

acceptance.output_limit_note: Project +/-5% acceptance target measured at the farthest module, including ripple/transients; not a tighter RECOM manufacturer guarantee.
checks: Power the offboard assembly first from a correctly polarized, current-limited 5 V supply, with J2 disconnected; verify VIN, VOUT and capacitor polarity.
Verify no short between VIN, GND and VOUT, and both J2 ground wires reach regulator pin 2.

Measure input/output startup and shutdown, hard plug at the external splitter, and 100-750 mA load steps with a scope; observe input-slew limit and rail targets. Do not hot-plug internal J2 or radio harnesses.
Exercise Ethernet, Z-Wave TX, CC1101 TX and BME680 heater concurrently; measure current and far-end voltage. The 400 mA figure remains an engineering reserve until measured.
Run the assembled enclosed hub to thermal equilibrium at its maximum intended ambient; respect the lowest component limit and RECOM derating, not its marketing temperature headline.

Flash boards while loose before soldering into the carrier. After assembly use supported OTA; USB service requires a separately verified power-isolation arrangement, or desoldering the board for loose-board service. Do not power an assembled radio alone from USB: D1-D3 do not block signal-pin backpower into the unpowered peripheral rail and VOUT.
Do not connect any board's local 3.3 V output to +3V3. No output-blocking diode is fitted, because its drop would alter the rail design.
acceptance.emc_status: System emissions not tested. The datasheet's EN55032 Class B result requires its external filter; the 27 uF input capacitor alone does not establish Class B compliance.
